routes.purpose: Resolve the bounded editorial/source state before reading history.
routes.authority: revision-bound repository documentation plus exact provider ref
routes.evidence_rule: state prose must be interpreted at its observed revision; exact current-head claims require provider metadata/readback

routes.purpose: Find the canonical engineering document without scanning the repository.
routes.evidence_rule: selected document path must exist at the bound ref

routes.purpose: Normalize portable context using the existing canonical V2 contract.
routes.authority: RafGitTools context bundle contract and implementation
routes.evidence_rule: schema validation plus implementation/test receipt bound to exact ref

routes.purpose: Route human/AI workspace reads, selections, patch proposals and source-linked responses through the existing control plane.
routes.authority: RafGitTools workspace architecture and producer-specific providers
routes.evidence_rule: provider-specific readback and exact target receipt; patch proposal alone is not execution

routes.purpose: Reconstruct/search NOVOexport context locally without rereading the full corpus.
routes.execution_target: local SQLite/index publication or bounded query
routes.evidence_rule: source hash/checkpoint and deterministic publication/query receipt

routes.purpose: Resolve a bounded session/package/role route for AI work without loading the whole map.
routes.authority: session dispatch adapter configuration and documentation
routes.evidence_rule: exact pinned route/config refs and structural validation

routes.purpose: Turn an approved staged change into a governed Git branch/commit/draft-PR flow.
routes.execution_target: non-protected branch plus draft pull request
routes.evidence_rule: base SHA + three-way comparison + dry-run + exact approval + commit/PR/readback + append-only receipt
